title: parseFeatures emits duplicate feature:cleric:destroy-undead from SRD 5.1 PDF
description:
With loreweaver-3m1's ancestry coverage fix landing, verify:dnd5e-srd-pack now passes the ancestry check but hits the next pipeline failure:

> importer failed: records has duplicate key: feature:cleric:destroy-undead

Reproduce: npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack on a tree that has loreweaver-3m1 merged.

Investigation pointers:
- This failure is pre-existing — it was masked by the AncestryCoverageError firing first. The progression-table feature parser likely emits Destroy Undead twice (perhaps once per progression-table row that lists it, or once via the leading-prose fallback and again via the table anchor).
- Cleric's class progression lists Destroy Undead at multiple character levels (2, 5, 8, 11, 14, 17) as the SAME feature gaining bigger effect — the parser should de-duplicate by (class, feature name) and keep the EARLIEST level, or rename later rows.
- See packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.ts.
- Tests live in packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.test.ts.
close_reason: Fixed by output-level dedup+merge in parseFeatures when the same (grantor, name) anchor matches twice — covers both Cleric Destroy Undead in-body table caption and Warlock Eldritch Invocations end-of-chapter option-list. PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/136 open against main. Follow-up loreweaver-9bu filed for the next pipeline failure (subclass:champion duplicate in parseSubclasses).
